title: Design, fabrication and supply of Buoy and Lighthouse models for Marine Navigation Training Institute, Kolkata
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for design, fabrication and supply of buoy and lighthouse models for the Marine Navigation Training Institute (MNTI), Kolkata (Kolkata Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Marine Navigation Training Institute, Kolkata
sites.work: Supply of buoy and lighthouse models for training

scope.item: Design, fabrication and supply of Buoy and Lighthouse models

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/commercial bank in favour of Director, DLL Kolkata, or valid MSME/NSIC certificate (exemption for registration in the subject work); original EMD/hard copy of certificate to reach office by 18.09.2024. Tender fee 'Not Applicable'.

notes: Section 1 NIT only; number, types and scale of models not stated. Bid submission 22.08.2024 to 18.09.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 19.09.2024 16:00; pre-bid 04.09.2024 15:00. Bid validity not stated in NIT.
